inject_and_call_public.meaning: injectAndCall is publicly callable and not restricted to the delegatecall context

anyone_can_call.meaning: an arbitrary external account is able to invoke injectAndCall directly

attacker_targets.meaning: the direct external caller can supply an arbitrary target and callData

erc20_drained.meaning: the router's entire ERC20 token balance can be transferred to the attacker via the freshly granted allowance

delegatecall_context_authorized.meaning: the call occurs in the delegatecall context for which injectAndCall was designed

token_transfer_authorized.meaning: the router's ERC20 balance movement is authorized (only in delegatecall context)

external_call_move_authorized.meaning: an external caller may move router-held ERC20 balances to an arbitrary target

assumptions: The report describes a possible capability rather than a confirmed executed drain.
The report does not confirm the router held a nonzero ERC20 balance at the relevant time.
The report does not specify the concrete token, target, or callData used in any real call.
The delegatecall-restriction function or modifier name onlyDelegatecall is referenced but its implementation is not provided.

unresolved.description: Whether the scenario is an observed incident or a possible capability; the impact statements use 'can' and 'enables' rather than confirming an executed ERC20 drain.
The parameter list of injectAndCall (how callers supply target and callData) is not provided, so the exact external-call surface is unclear.
The ERC20 balance amount, token decimals, and allowance units are not reported; the model stays at the whole-balance capability level.

limitations: The ETH-drain impact eth_drained is available but deferred so this plan formalizes exactly one direct relation.
The unauthorized_transfer impact is available but deferred for future claims.
The only_delegatecall_guard intent is an inferred desired behavior; the report does not provide the guard's implementation.
The model is purely semantic; no AST, code binding, coverage, or truth verdict is produced.
